newsitem.title: TURKEY: Leading Turkish general to visit Israel.
newsitem.headline: Leading Turkish general to visit Israel.

text.p: The second in command of Turkey's secularist armed forces is to travel to Israel this weekend in the latest of a series of high-level visits focused on defence cooperation, an Israeli embassy official said on Friday.

He said General Cevik Bir would visit the Jewish state on Sunday. Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai, hosting Turkey's defence minister, said on Thursday he favoured joint military manoeuvres by the two countries and the United States.
The army's close ties to Israel are a setback to Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's efforts to direct Turkey towards better relations with its Moslem neighbours.
A military training agreement between Turkey and Israel last year drew an angry response from Iran and many in the Arab world. Israeli planes have flown training flights in Turkey under the accord.
The army, which sees itself as the guarantor of Turkey's secularist tradition, has put Erbakan under intense pressure at home to crack down on Islamist activism.
